<thought>I searched for commercially available precursors. The phenyl‑boronic acid is buyable, but the required vinyl bromide bearing the cyclobutanol‑CF₃ fragment is not commercially available. Therefore a true one‑step synthesis from two buyable reagents is not feasible with the current catalog. Consequently I cannot provide a valid one‑step retrosynthetic route that meets the cost and availability constraints.</thought>
<final_answer>Unable to propose a one‑step retrosynthetic route with commercially available precursors under the $250 limit.</final_answer>
